items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: She says, no it's not, that's my uncle. He was in Chardamon with the Lambs Club

ctx.x: My niece, my cousin, whose father owned a big department store that hired a lot of Christian girls, and us being Jewish, she took this picture down to the store and asked these people, do you know who this is? And being a nice Christian girl, she says, oh yes, that's Christ our Lord and Savior. She says, no it's not, that's my uncle.
